name: GNOME System Monitor
description:
GNOME System Monitor is an essential system diagnostic utility for Linux desktops. It provides real-time information on active processes, resource utilization, and storage filesystems.

Features:
- Real-time CPU, memory, swap, and network bandwidth utilization graphs
- Detailed process list with search, sorting, priority control, and termination options
- Filesystem overview detailing disk usage, mount points, and partition capacities
- Inspection of process memory maps, open files, and execution arguments
- Responsive GTK user interface designed for clarity and ease of use
